nom: COSRX AHA/BHA Treatment Toner for Whiteheads & Clogged Pores

avis.titre: I finally found my holy grail product for acne
avis.texte: It's been a very long journey of me searching for the perfect product that doesn't make me break out and is not too oily for my oily skin. I did have my reservations before ordering this but I figured it is worth a try. I have occasional acne, a few pimples here and there, along with old acne scars that never faded. I've tried vitamin C serums and salicylic acid before to no avail. Here is my nightly routine before bed: 1. Hada Labo Hyaluronic Foam Cleanser 2. COSRX AHA/BHA Toner 3. Hada Labo Gokujun Hyaluronic Lotion 4. COSRX Snail Mucin 96% Power Repairing Essence 5. Nature Republic Aloe Gel (as an extra moisturizer when I feel like it) 6. SoonJung Panthensoside Cica Balm (only for spot treatments or those colder nights) The first few days it is not noticeable that it's doing anything different. However after a few weeks, I noticed I've been getting a lot less breakouts. And my acne scars have started to fade. After two months, my complexion has evened out even more (the scars are still there, but it's just less red and blends in more with the rest of my face). Then I decided to stop using the AHA/BHA toner spray for a week because I was running low, and I immediately started getting a few pimples. I guess that's my sign that I must start stocking this product regularly! I have read reviews on AHA/BHA products in general and it's advised to use this product at night because it will make your skin more sensitive. If you use it in the day, you MUST use sunscreen afterwards. I

I’ve been using the COSRX AHA/BHA Clarifying Treatment Toner for a while now and I’m really impressed with the results. My skin feels smoother, looks brighter, and my texture has improved a lot. It’s gentle on the skin, doesn’t leave my face feeling dry, and helps keep my pores looking cleaner. I also noticed fewer breakouts and my skincare products absorb better after using it. Definitely a great toner for anyone wanting a gentle exfoliating product!”

avis.titre: Sensitive skin approved! (for me, at least)Sensitive skin approved! (for me, at least)
avis.texte: The perfect toner for anyone with sensitive/reactive skin like mine. My face blows up in red blotchy spots with most products but this toner has never done me wrong. This + their snail mucin serums have been part of my go-to routine for 7 years now. I sweat every day and have to wash my face often. This toner keeps my skin hydrated and ready for the day!
I have bought this a few times. Don’t know if it’s this or vitamin c serum but it Even out my dark spots on my face. Good buy.

This is my only repurchase of any toner I’ve ever used. It’s shocking how much smoother my skin feels when I use this. I’ve tried several others trying to use up what I’ve had but I’m converted. Great product, great price.
My daughter likes this COSRX toner. She is happy with how it works for her and has no complaints. She gets a lot of compliments on her skin!
I absolutely love this toner. I use it every morning and I have noticed a difference in my acne and the brightness of my skin. I will be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Controls sebum and gentle for daily use.Controls sebum and gentle for daily use.
avis.texte: I am an oily sensitive skin girl, so i do have to check precisely before applying anything on my skin. I like minimal products in my skincare so i wanted a toner which can do more than just control sebum. Then i came across this gem and i am happy that i bought it. I bought it for 660 something on sale and I saying it is worth every rps, the quality is 150 ml i am using it twice a day and it is gonna last 3-4 more months. I am posting this review after using it for 2 weeks and my skin has less sebum, no tiny bumps and no open pores. It has lightnen my dark acne marks and i think the skin texture has also slightly improved. Regular use will show the better results. I am goning to stick to it.❤️ The packaging was nice no damage or leakage of the product.

Tengo un mes usandolo y he notado mi piel mas suave y con menos apariencia de poros, me ayudo con la descamación y con la grasa de la piel. ALGO IMPORTANTE A RESALTAR: Tengan cuidado con la purga de piel, los primeros tres dias me salio mucha textura que no tenia antes, pero es una reacción normal a los componentes porque esta depurando la piel. No es malo ya que se ira en menos de una semana y saldra la piel bonita. 💕
Exfoliante suave y efectivo… lo utilizo por las noches en días alternados 👍🏻

This was recommended to me as an alternative to Clinique #4 toner for oily skin, which I loved but was so high in alcohol content that it made me cough every time I used it. This toner is just as good for oily skin, but kinda more gentle and definitely has less alcohol. It’s a spray bottle so it feels refreshing to spray directly on your face. Even though you’re supposed to spray on a cotton round and wipe. Either way, it’s a solid toner that’s comparable to higher end brands.

avis.titre: It works but can be a little drying
avis.texte: Ok sooo chat gpt recommended this toner for me based on my skin profile and It’s fair to say that it did a pretty decent job. Compared to my other toners it’s not as gentle and can be a little drying but its easy to keep up with compared to another toner from this brand that I find just to harsh for my skin type. I notice actual results in the following days proceeding and I found a sweet spot of about 3 x per week rather than daily. This paired with some snail mucinex and a ceramide is definitely my power combo for my sensitive/ dry skin.

avis.titre: Love it! Worked wonderfully for me.
avis.texte: I rarely write Amazon reviews but I just had to come here to say how much I love this product! I have combination oily and dry very sensitive skin. I break out easily to new products (had a recent horrible breakout to biore sunscreen too). It's been about 14 days since I started using this and oh my lord, it has helped my skin smoothen out so much and decreased breakouts. I started using it because I learned BHA can help with sebaceous filaments which I had grown an unusually large amount on my face these past few months. It did made me purge in the first week (had giant whiteheads and pustules) but my skin is calmer now and smoother. I pair this with Cerave facial cleanser and Avene skin recovery cream and it's a miracle combo! The only thing I don't like is the spray top. It doesn't work very well misting it on face or applying by hand. You have to follow the instructions to wet a cotton pad and smoothe over skin for it to be fully effective in my opinion and that's worked better for me. I'll definitely keep buying this for sure.

I have dry sensitive skin! I have no idea why I thought that this product would be compatible with my skin type! Don't get me wrong, I absolutely LOVE LOVE LOVE COSRX!!! But I came to the conclusion that this product would be too harsh for my sensitive skin! Never opened! Never used! I can't attest to it's effectiveness! But what did give me the glowey, dewy and glass like skin in the picture above was the COSRX Propolis line! Tried and true and definitely recommend! That's what I'm giving a 5⭐️ review for!

avis.titre: I have really sensitive skin so not sure
avis.texte: I've been using this clarifying treatment toner for about a week now, and I'm giving it 3 stars because I'm still on the fence about its effectiveness. Initially, I was excited to try this product as it promised to balance my skin's pH and reduce acne. However, after using it consistently for 2 weeks, I've started to experience a breakout - which is the opposite of what I was hoping for. That being said, I do think this toner has helped to reduce the appearance of pores and has left my skin feeling clean and refreshed. The breakout could be due to a purging phase, but I'm not entirely sure. I'll continue to use this product and see how my skin adjusts, but for now, I can only give it an average rating. If you're considering trying this toner, I'd recommend starting with a small patch test to see how your skin reacts.
I've been using this set for over a year now and the difference is just amazing. I've struggled with cystic acne for most of my life, so I'm extremely grateful I finally found what works!:)

7/16/20 UPDATED REVIEW: Product works. I can see a visible difference in the texture of my skin. Seems to be smoothing bumps, decreasing wrinkles and also solved a weird problem area I had where the side of my left cheek was appearing shribbled/wrinkled or just aging faster...it completely helped and smoothed the area. I still prefer the product arrive w/out a smashed box so I’m leaving the review at 4 stars instead of 3. I will continue to use it and look forward to seeing further results. Product arrived in broken/smashed box. Not sure if this is the real thing because I saw another reviewer that said the same thing but her cap was also missing. The spray cap works and the product is misting but it’s hard to tell if the product is authentic. I went by the store’s reviews and they seemed legit and had positive ratings. I hope this product will work. So far it just seems like a very light toner water. I hope it can clear up some texture and bumps on my face. I will try to update this review.

I bought the toner once in Marshalls and tried others, but I just came back to this one, because I truly loved it. Couldn’t find it at Marshalls or Tj Maxx so I decided to buy it in Amazon Second time purchasing the toner. I would buy again, and I do recommend this product.

avis.titre: Great Deal, good for seven skin method
avis.texte: First off this toner and in general this brand skincare works wonder and is made accessible to everyone with its prices. $11 for a 150ml toner !?!?!! I use this after double cleanseing and on my average working day I put on 3 layers(skins) and on my off day I do seven layer. Since this toner is in a mist form it hydrating and can be patted down easily for the seven skin method. With it anti acne and exfoliating properties from aha/bha this toner is a nice multi tasker. My acne has gone down significantly.

My redness and pigmentation has significantly gone down. I did a lot of research on this product and heard great reviews from friends and professionals. In the beginning of of using it, my skin did purge because I think this product extracts the bad bacteria from the skin, but after a few weeks of using it, my skin is soft and smooth. My skin type is dry and acne prone.
I like this toner. It’s gentle with skin and it’s refreshing. I like the spray presentation, it’s easy to apply.
In love with this spray toner! It is lightweight and it does not irritate my face! I use it night and day before adding anything else to my face.

A+ Not as hydrating as the glow recipe one I use but girl does it work! In just 48hours my skin is calm, glowing and my pores are blurred. I have oily skin that will break any foundation and with this paired with my retinol. I don’t need foundation! I won’t say it cures my acne but definitely prevents more
Simply love this brand! Haven’t used a toner in a while and this one is great for sensitive skin!

I didn't try out the product, so I feel a little guilty rating it (still, I'll give it three stars, because I'm so nice :). But... when I buy cosmetics, they are SEALED, both container and box. Neither of these were ; I have no way of knowing if this is a real COSRX product or paint thinner.

avis.titre: Toner for wrinkles and more kinds
avis.texte: I bought this because I got good reviews from this product. I use a toner every morning and night time. I am excited to try this on. Hope it will work better on my face!
Product came open and leaking (used maybe??) kind of scared to even try it not knowing how clean it may be now.
It’s my second bottle, but the first one I bought in US. The previous one I bought in South Korea. It’s original, I don’t see any difference. Quite affordable for the good quality. Love it!
Heavyweight packaging, English instructions as well, will update on how my skin reacts. I’m usually sensitive combination with occasional hormonal acne so hopefully these acids will work well for me.

As soon as I used the toner it broke me out so bad from my face to my neck!! I bought all of there items for facial, and was so excited when I received each item, but with this that has happen with the toner I’m afraid to use the rest of the other stuff.

avis.titre: Didn’t even get to try it!
avis.texte: Speedy delivery but that was expected because of prime membership. Box was not sealed nor taped and showed signs of wear & tear. Product looked like it’s been used as evidenced by the moisture/condensation/watermarks on the lid. (Pls see photo). I so wanted to try this but I was afraid that product may already be contaminated so I didn’t attempt to try it out. This will definitely be returned!!

I have sooooo many products from this line and every single one of them are absolutely amazing! i have very sensitive skin and i can’t do the harsh chemicals and scented stuff. There are very few things that won’t break me out and this whole line is amazing on my skin! you seriously can’t go wrong with anything in this line. i just recently got started on this self care journey at the age of 34 lol and it’s made SUCH A DIFFERENCE already! i highly suggest anything from this line! you won’t be disappointed! As a matter of fact i reorder the items whenever i get halfway done with an item so that i never have to go without it! Just order it! 😬😍
I used it for two weeks and I stopped because I noticed my red turned face and it felt like it was burning

I would love to write a review on the product, however this is how it arrived. The box was open and the top was not in there. I have no way of using it and of course it is not returnable. Waste of money.
This is my 4th order. The bottle came with no cover this time and it's dirty on top.
I received a completely defective item, the box looks rough and the bottle is just empty!
My item came in half empty because the lid wasn’t capped on properly...the whole package was wet. I’m extremely dissatisfied and will demand a refund.

I’ve been struggling with acne for a very long time and this has been the product that makes my face super smooth. Currently on my period as well and I maybe have 2 pimples at most. I have very dry, flaky skin and it balances my face to normal.

no scent at all. coats whole face in just a few sprits. Leaves skin feeling soft, light, and airy. An excellent toner. I love the simplicity of it. No obnoxious packaging and promises and all the marketing tricks they try these days. the bottle is simple. the ingredients are simple. and the results are simple - IT WORKS!

I love this! I just spray a little on a cotton ball, and just lightly smooth it across my skin, get maybe two more cotton balls and I'm done! Lifts the dirt off of my skin easily Non-comedogenic so it won't clog your pores. Remember: cleanse, tone, moisturize. COSRX is my go to.

It made me breakout in red itchy welts on my face & chest. I know it caused the reaction because it was just after me spraying the bottle. It was at night, the second time I used it I sprayed it on my chest and face and after 3 minutes I got a noticeable, red, welt like pimple, it was almost like an allergic reaction. It not only formed on my cheek, but I also found some on my chest too; it feels like a bump.. I'm glad I can get a free refund. My skin type is normal-dehydrated/dry in the winter. I just wanted a good toner that was beneficial to my skin, this was not it; that is why because I'm worried I will get more itchy bumps from this product I will be returning it.
Love the price and works great on my skin. Doesn’t have a weird smell. After using this for only a week I could tell a difference in my skin.

I never write reviews, but my friend if you suffer from hyperpigmentation, freckles, or any small brownish scars I highly recommend you try this toner. Works really well and is a good relationship quality/price. Try it!

avis.titre: Box came opened with product leaking (seems used?)
avis.texte: I ordered this two days ago and was so excited to use it; however, the box came opened and it seems like it has been used already. There was no seal or anything in the box so I am not sure if the toner has something different in it or if someone has tampered with it. As you can see from the photo it seems like there is a lot of product missing. Overall, disappointed.
